data.gender_notes: Jamison is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English name ‘Geames’ which translates to ‘Son of Jacob’. This name was popular among the early Christians, especially in England. The name Jamison carries the meaning “Son of Jacob” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jamison usually hope their child will grow to embody son of jacob and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the biblical figure Jacob, symbolizing strength and tenacity.
data.etymology: Jamison belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of Jacob.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamison total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jamison holds a rich cultural history for Christians. In England, during the Middle Ages, the name was common among those who traced their lineage back to the patriarch, Jacob, revered in the Bible as the father of 12 sons, who laid the foundation for the Twelve Tribes of Israel. Jamison is a testament to these roots, drawing heritage from an esteemed figure of the Judeo-Christian tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Jamison, meaning 'Son of Jacob', holds an essential spiritual significance. The Hebrew patriarch, Jacob, is considered a revered figure in the Bible for his unwavering faith and God's rewards for his unwavering devotion. Naming a child Jamison signifies allegiance to the religious legacy of faith, perseverance, and trust in the mercy and justice of God, reminding the bearer of the name of the spiritual strengths and virtues key to living a life in accordance to the Divine.
